# Signal Weekly — Nov 2–Nov 9, 2026

*Nov 2–Nov 9, 2026*

This week’s tech digest brings a mix of regulatory buzz, AI breakthroughs, and gaming upgrades—plus a few handy system tweaks. From Nvidia’s legal heat to new AI models, there’s plenty to keep your tech radar sharp.

## Tech news

- **[The race is on to sue Nvidia](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/the-race-is-on-to-sue-nvidia/)** (TechCrunch) — Nvidia faces potential regulatory fallout that could reshape its market position.
- **[How agentic AI raises the bar for law firms](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/agentic-ai-raises-bar-law-firms)** (The Information) — Agentic AI promises to boost legal efficiency, though adoption hurdles remain.
- **[ByteDance’s Seedream 5.5 can edit one image 100 times without breaking it](https://thenextweb.com/news/bytedance-seedream-5-5-image-editing-100-rounds)** (The Next Web) — Seedream 5.5 lets designers edit one image 100 times without loss, a boon for creative workflows.

## Reviews

- **[5 Nintendo Switch 2 features everyone should know about](https://www.engadget.com/2307744/nintendo-switch-2-features-everyone-should-know/)** (Engadget) — The Switch 2’s new connectivity and sharing features promise a smoother gaming experience.
- **[Windows 11 is finally adding an easier way to disable the Sticky Keys pop-up](https://www.engadget.com/2311340/windows-11-is-finally-adding-an-easier-way-to-disable-sticky-keys-pop-up/)** (Engadget) — Windows 11 now makes disabling the Sticky Keys pop‑up a one‑click fix, easing accessibility settings.
